why: Both say: on day 2, with the table piling on your unnamed wolf partner, say nothing that defends or links you; 58fab0f9 adds the single neutral remark and the fallback if your silence is questioned.
Both say: early on, while role claims clash and nobody names you, stay unclaimed, ask a neutral question and cite no body-derived info; b5e241ee also covers being probed about your vote or silence.

All three say: early (day 2-3), vote with the majority for the player corroborated by watch/follow reports or a claim collision, keeping role and bullets hidden; 83a7d3d3 also says to voice your read before the vote.
Both say: late with several evil players alive, drive the accusation from public records, hide role and bullet and keep the shot for night; 008b6f96 adds when it becomes right to reveal.
Both say: on a blind opening night keep both sigils; f9844c8f also notes that a no-effect result cannot distinguish a non-attacker.
Both say: after an abstain-heavy day, put the last watch on the likeliest kill target rather than a vote-based suspect; 040f01ab also says how to read a visitor or an empty door.
Both say: when a visit report names you, redirect the vote to the other visitor whose evidence already exists; a44cdbd5 adds the reframe of a visit as not proof and the aim to split the vote.
